column1: # Prerequisite tools for building zclassic23 — the single source of truth.
# `make doctor` (tools/scripts/doctor.sh) reads this file, probes the host,
# and prints the install line for ONLY what is missing. It also asserts that
# every `need <tool>` call in tools/scripts/build_vendor.sh has a row here, so
# a new vendor prerequisite cannot be added without appearing in the doctor.
# That assertion is why this file, not prose, is authoritative: three separate
# with each other and with the script, and none of them listed perl, nm or tar.
#   class   required        — the node build cannot proceed without it
#           vendor          — `make vendor` (the one-time archive build) needs it
#           vendor-optional — the build completes without it; something is
#                             slower, on a fallback path, or a named optional
#                             capability is absent. Never counted as a missing
#           vendor-either   — at least ONE tool in this class must be present
#   why     what breaks without it, in one clause
# Package names are per-distro and deliberately not deduplicated: the doctor
# prints one install line per manager, and duplicates there are harmless.
